text: 'A small truck': concept art, 1 designs to choose from, then up to 1 rounds of notes

concept: A LEGO model of a small boxy delivery truck with a short hood, a chunky cab, and a rectangular cargo box, built from stacked bricks and plates with rolling wheels. (changed: Kept the truck stationary with all wheels on the ground instead of mid-motion; Simplified cargo box to a plain rectangular brick shape rather than doors that open or complex panels)
drawing the concept as an official LEGO set
turning the concept to see its side and back
reading the concept and writing the build brief
comparing the renders with the concept

score 3/10: Overall silhouette is too low and squashed — reads as a blobby car/van, not a boxy delivery truck; Cargo box is rounded/curved on top instead of a flat-topped studded white box; Cab roof is domed with curved slopes rather than the flat yellow cab roof with pronounced hood
reworking the design from the critic's notes
comparing the renders with the concept

score 3/10: Cab is a flat stack of exposed-stud plates with no hood/roof shaping — reads as a brick slab, not a truck cab; Windscreen is a tiny sliver of trans-blue instead of the tall wraparound windshield; cab has no visible roof over it; Wheels are tiny and half-buried in the chassis; no wheel arches, ride height far too low so the model reads as a train car
